Forecast a Time Jumped AR error series

Source: R/12-tj-ar.R
forecast_tj_ar.Rd

Estimate modal weights from non-consecutive historic errors separated by jump timesteps, then project the characteristic-root solution forwards.

Usage

forecast_tj_ar(
  parameters,
  error_history,
  jump = 1L,
  steps = 480L,
  time_step_minutes = 15
)

Arguments

parameters

An AR parameter set.

error_history

Numeric error history supplied newest first. It must contain at least 1 + (order - 1) * jump values.

jump

Positive whole number of timesteps between selected errors. Use 1L for conventional consecutive-error AR.

steps

Positive whole number of projected timesteps.

time_step_minutes

Minutes represented by one timestep.

Value

An object of class tj_ar_forecast containing selected inputs, modal weights, root contributions and projected error.

Examples

history <- c(0.20, 0.19, 0.23, 0.18, 0.17, 0.16, 0.15, 0.14, 0.13, 0.12, 0.11)
result <- forecast_tj_ar(default_ar_parameters(), history, jump = 5L, steps = 24L)
tj_ar_series(result)
